findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization via pickle.load/loads, yaml.load, marshal.load, or shelve.open

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name HTML/JS injection in markup processing
 * @description Potential XSS or HTML injection in markup/text processing
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/html-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("html").getMember(["escape", "unescape"]).getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
select call, "Potential code execution or HTML processing that could be vulnerable to injection"
findings.hypothesis: Check for potential HTML/JS injection or code execution in markup processing

message.text: Potential code execution or HTML processing that could be vulnerable to injection
